newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers stable, ARA enquiries high.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers stable, ARA enquiries high.

text.p: European bunkers paused for breath on Thursday, resting unchanged after a steady week of gains, dealers said.
Activity in most ports was thin, except in ARA where there were many small enquiries, although traded volume amounted to little, traders said.
"It was very active this afternoon, but shipowners tried to take as little as possible," one supplier said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil stayed in the range $125-$126 fob, after the barge market fell back from initial gains. Gas oil and diesel weakened in line with screen losses.
Hamburg was also stable, 380 CST fuel oil at around $127 fob, although, unlike in Rotterdam, the market was dead.

Mediterranean ports were mixed. In Fos prices rose, catching up with Rotterdam strength early this week. In Italy, the market sagged after sharp gains on Wednesday. Only in Spain, was bunkering active.
Fujairah bunkers were steady at $116/$118, although traders said they expected the market to weaken in line with losses further east.
Durban bunkers gained about $2, 180 CST at $130/$132.
